Links: [{"title":"lovable pricing","url":"https://www.websitebuilderexpert.com/vibe-coding/lovable-pricing/"},{"title":"lovable pricing explained credits plans and real monthly cost 2026","url":"https://www.fuzen.io/posts/lovable-pricing-explained-credits-plans-and-real-monthly-cost-2026"},{"title":"lovable pricing guide pros cons alternatives","url":"https://www.dotsquares.com/press-and-events/tech/lovable-pricing-guide-pros-cons-alternatives"},{"title":"Published on","url":"https://www.softr.io/blog/lovable-pricing"},{"title":"lovable hidden costs","url":"https://www.lowcode.agency/blog/lovable-hidden-costs"},{"title":"Pricing & Credits","url":"https://gptprompts.ai/lovable-answers/how-much-does-lovable-really-cost-per-month"},{"title":"A complete guide to Lovable pricing in 2025","url":"https://www.eesel.ai/blog/lovable-pricing"},{"title":"Published on","url":"https://v2.softr.io/blog/lovable-pricing"},{"title":"lovable pricing","url":"https://www.zite.com/blog/lovable-pricing"}]
SUMMARY (tool-written): No single "maintenance" price exists for Lovable. Costs come from its subscription tiers, plus credits and third-party services once an app is live.
- Subscription tiers: Pro starts at $25 per month when billed monthly, or about $21 per month when billed annually. Business is $50 monthly or $42 annually. (websitebuilderexpert, Softr)
- Free plan: available indefinitely, capped at 30 credits per month. (websitebuilderexpert)
- Quiet months: One guide estimates that a month spent only maintaining a shipped app costs roughly the Pro sticker price. (gptprompts.ai)
- Active months: The same source puts all-in costs at about $75 to $150 once credit top-ups are added. (gptprompts.ai)
- Hosting and backend: Lovable Cloud includes a $25 monthly hosting allowance and a $1 monthly AI allowance. Apps that get real use can exceed these and are billed on usage. (Zite)
- Full stack: A fuzen.io estimate puts the realistic monthly total at $91 to $131 once Vercel or Netlify hosting, Supabase, and credit overages are included. (fuzen.io)
These figures come from third-party blogs, not Lovable's official pricing page.
